script_text: crAPI, crapi-1. This is an after-run replay of a lab exam, not a live attack. The agent LLM for this run was gpt-oss:20b. 8 agents produced 33 events over a 839-second window. Each row is one agent; each column is a stage, from human on the left to publish on the right. Most activity was in the proven-gate stage, with 17 events. The first publish came 133 seconds in. Coverage: 7 endpoints, 1 finding, 0 verified. Nearby dots are not proof that the agents coordinated.
